info.bio:
Modest Mouse son una banda de rock alternativo de los Estados Unidos. Se formó en 1993 en Issaquah, en el estado de Washington. Sus componentes son el guitarra Isaac Brock, el batería Jeremiah Green y el bajo Eric Judy. Desde que firmaron por la filial de Sony Epic Records en 2000, la banda ha alcanzado un éxito popular bastante significativo.

En 1994 la banda hizo su grabación debut, el EP Blue Cadet-3, Do You Connect?, en los estudios de Calvin Jonson, trabajo que fue lanzado por el sello K Records del propio Calvin.

scenes.name: Lo-fi pop
scenes.author: Piero Scaruffi
scenes.desc: El gran invento de los independientes neozelandeses se convierte en uno de los fenómenos mundiales de los noventa: Cakekitchen, Bailter Space, Underground Lovers, King Loser; en Australia, Blackeyed Susans y Moles. En EE UU, Olympia (Beat Happening, Some Velvet Sidewalk, Spinanes), Modest Mouse y, sobre todo, Pavement, el grupo lo-fi más influyente (Slanted And Enchanted), con su contagio por todo el país (Silver Jews, Crowsdell). La vertiente más creativa, heredera de Half Japanese y los Residents: Trumans Water, Velocity Girl, Heavy Vegetable, Quintron, Danielson Famile, Soul Junk.

podcast.title: Alt Rock Resurgence of 2004
podcast.body: Modest Mouse was named as one of the new and exciting bands contributing to the resurgence of Alt Rock by 2004. "By 2004, Alt Rock was back with all kinds of new exciting bands that was Franz Ferdinand and Modest Mouse and the Killers and Billy Towns and the Stills and Jet, the Ye-Yaz and Hot Hot Heat."

podcast.title: Breakthrough from Obscurity (Pre-2005)
podcast.body: After "years of obscurity," the band "started selling albums by the millions" by spring 2005, marking a significant rise during the rock renaissance. "After years of obscurity, modest mouse started selling albums by the millions."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The History of Alt Rock Chapter: 14

podcast.title: Isaac Brock's Difficult Youth
podcast.body: Isaac Brock, the frontman, experienced a turbulent childhood, including being homeschooled for a period. His mother left his father for his father's brother, and their house subsequently flooded, leading her to move into her husband's trailer. With no space for Isaac, he stayed on the second floor of the flooded house until authorities intervened. "Family life was a little messed up for Isaac. He was homeschooled for a while but then his mum left his father for his father's brother than the house flooded which meant that she had to move into her husband's trailer. But there was no space in the trailer for Isaac so he stayed at the flooded out house on the second floor until the cops made a move."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Issaquah, Washington Origins - Population 36,081
podcast.body: Modest Mouse originated from Issaquah, Washington, a town with a population of 36,081, located just outside Seattle. The proximity to Seattle's booming music scene served as an inspiration for the band members to pursue music. "The biggest place that we're going to deal with is Isakwa, Washington. This is a place just outside of Seattle and it's very famous for its salmon hatchery. The most optimistic sense is puts the population at 36,081 souls."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Long-standing Critical Acclaim to Mainstream Success
podcast.body: Formed in 1992, Modest Mouse initially garnered critical acclaim but achieved widespread recognition and popularity only in the mid-2000s, particularly with their fourth album. Their unique sound during this period aligned with the emerging New Wave Revival, offering something distinct from the prevailing rock trends. "Although the band had been around since 1992, they really didn't come into their own until the middle of the odds."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Pavement's Influence
podcast.body: Modest Mouse was identified as a group influenced by Pavement, showing how the pioneering Lofi band's style shaped subsequent indie rock acts. "Pavement's influence would later be heard in the music of late 90s blur, and also groups like Modest Mouse, Spoon, and The Walkman."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Rehearsal Space - The Shed
podcast.body: After living in a friend's basement for a while, Isaac Brock built a shack next to his mother's trailer, which they named "the shed." This structure became the primary rehearsal space for Modest Mouse in their early days. "After living in a friend's basement for a while, Isaac built a shack next to the trailer and this became the rehearsal space for modest mouse. They called it the shed."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Seattle Scene Inspiration
podcast.body: The vibrant and "exploding" music scene in nearby Seattle was a significant source of inspiration for Modest Mouse to create and perform music. "Isaac first picked up a base when he was 15 and then switched to guitar after boring one from a friend and at the time things were exploding nearby Seattle which was an inspiration for everybody to do something."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.title: Talking Heads Comparison
podcast.body: In the mid-2000s, Modest Mouse was noted for a sound reminiscent of Talking Heads. This comparison highlights a stylistic influence and the emergence of more varied sounds in the rock landscape of 2006-2007. "Modest mouse sounded like a reincarnation of the talking heads."
